dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly irregular and crenulated light-intensity perimeters forming 'O' and 'C' shapes. There is a high-contrast, sharp transition from the dark charcoal exterior to the light-grey border, which typically encloses a darker or multi-toned interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous, solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated primarily in the anterior-dorsal region and along the upper lateral curve, lacking any defined interior gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent 'O' structures on the mid-lateral surface form an irregular, elongated pentagonal polygon with varying interior angles and unequal side lengths.
